ground_truth: Under Ordinance No. 0291-17 Section 44, commercial sand and gravel extraction requires a Permit to Quarry from CENRO, an approved Business Permit, and monthly extraction reports. The extraction fee is PHP 30.00 per cubic meter, with an annual fee of PHP 1,500.00 to PHP 3,500.00 based on area size.
